    Arity bounds for literal string almost-split sequences #

    The Butler--Ringel boundary complexes have either one literal string in the middle or a binary biproduct of literal strings. This file records their displayed indecomposable decompositions and packages the resulting minimal right almost-split maps with the uniform bound two.
